package.name: gazebo_jointed_chain
package.description: Gazebo model plugin: a jointed chain (e.g. a cable carrier) between two links of a model, built at load from parameters (capsule links, universal joints with bend limits and damping, a collide bitmask shared only with chosen collisions of the host model); publishes the clamp forces, the chain's strain and its link end points, re-hangs it on a reset service and can call a stop service above a strain or force threshold. Simulation only.
